context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 contact sheets, each 48 frames (6 columns x 8 rows, chronological) from a single Tesla Sentry field clip recorded by the owner's own car. For EACH image, decide whether anything physically touched the car anywhere in the clip. Output exactly one line per event:
<event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 12 words>
Definitions: contact = something physically touches the car; near_miss = a person or object approaches closely but no contact is visible; quiet = nobody/nothing approaches; unclear = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: raspberrypi-2026-07-20_15-29-04
Image 2: raspberrypi-2026-07-20_15-32-55
Image 3: raspberrypi-2026-07-20_17-56-58
Image 4: raspberrypi-2026-07-20_18-02-00
Image 5: raspberrypi-2026-07-20_18-13-00
response:
raspberrypi-2026-07-20_15-29-04: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Static storefront scene; no visible approach or contact.
raspberrypi-2026-07-20_15-32-55: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=person pushing shopping cart; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Passes along sidewalk near car; no contact visible.
raspberrypi-2026-07-20_17-56-58: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Surrounding parked vehicles remain stationary; no visible approach.
raspberrypi-2026-07-20_18-02-00: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=vehicle at left edge; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Vehicle passes close along left edge; no contact visible.
raspberrypi-2026-07-20_18-13-00: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=Distant background movement only; nothing visibly approaches the recording car.
